# Virtuse

> Non-custodial hub for Bitcoin-only services. Virtuse never holds your keys.

As of Q3 2026. Indicative 2026 overview – not tax advice. Partner KYC on each platform.

## Bitcoin tax (11 EU countries)

- [Czechia](https://staging.virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/czechia/): 15 % income tax (23 % above threshold). Tax-free after 3-year holding (time test). As of Q3 2026.
- [Slovakia](https://staging.virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/slovakia/): 19 % income tax (25 % above threshold). Tax-free after 1-year holding; occasional-income allowance €500/yr. As of Q3 2026.
- [Poland](https://staging.virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/poland/): 19 % flat capital gains tax. No holding-period exemption. As of Q3 2026.
- [Austria](https://staging.virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/austria/): 27.5 % KESt (capital gains tax). Gains tax-free after 1-year holding (private investors). As of Q3 2026.
- [Germany](https://staging.virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/germany/): Up to 45 % income tax (progressive). 0 % after 1-year holding (private-sale exemption). As of Q3 2026.
- [Hungary](https://staging.virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/hungary/): 15 % capital gains tax. No holding-period exemption. As of Q3 2026.
- [Slovenia](https://staging.virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/slovenia/): Progressive, up to ~50 % on disposal gains. No general holding exemption. As of Q3 2026.
- [Croatia](https://staging.virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/croatia/): 12 % on digital-asset gains (2025; 10 % in 2024). No holding-period exemption. As of Q3 2026.
- [Romania](https://staging.virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/romania/): 10 % income tax on crypto gains. No holding-period exemption. As of Q3 2026.
- [Bulgaria](https://staging.virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/bulgaria/): 10 % flat tax on gains. No holding-period exemption. As of Q3 2026.
- [Netherlands](https://staging.virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/netherlands/): Box 3 wealth tax on deemed return (~36 % on fictional yield). Tax-free allowance (~€57k per person, 2025). As of Q3 2026.

Hub: https://staging.virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/
